meta.designBasisNote: UMD material curves are already design-level (gmc,ULS = 1.000 with a 27.62 MPa plateau, fyd = fy/1.111). This engine is therefore run at NOMINAL level on those same curves, so both sides are the same resistance level.

surfaces.label: 24 directions (default)
warnings: Strain domain: EN 1992-1-1 material laws are paired with the ACI/KDS concrete-pivot strain domain. EC2 domains 1–2 pivot on the reinforcement limit εud instead, so the tension-controlled part of this surface is not an EN 1992 boundary and the result is preview only. See docs/11-design-standards-and-resistance-formats.md §7.
